data.current_description:
Changes the telephone number(s) information by setting the values of the parameters passed. You must pass the x-customer-number parameter in the header to complete this call successfully. For this endpoint, the x-customer-number is the same as your Child BusOrg ID or the BusOrg assigned to the billing account number (BAN). A change request can update the following information: - Subscriber name - Directory Listing (DL) - Customer Service Name (CSN) - Service address - Caller Name Delivery (CNAM) - E911 options __Note:__ Directory Listing (DL) and the E911 option is not supported for Local Inbound (LI) telephone numbers.
#### Local Inbound (LI) telephone numbers The __orderMappingList__ array is a group of name-value pairs that are required based on the type of order you are changing. You can update the trunk group and route by using the name-value pair for __customerServiceName__ under the __orderMappingList__ object. See the example below. ``` "orderMappingList": [ { "attributeName": "customerServiceName", "attributeValue": "1AB-CD-3" } ] ```
#### Enhanced Local Service (ELS) telephone numbers __Required fields:__ ``` productID lnpIndicator subscriberLineList ``` The __orderMappingList__ array is a group of name-value pairs that are required based on the type of order you are changing. Below are the required fields for Directory Listing that you can include under the __orderMappingList__ object. ``` "orderMappingList": [ { "attributeName": "directoryListAction", "attributeValue": "" }, { "attributeName": "directoryListType", "attributeValue": "" }, { "attributeName": "directoryListType", "attributeValue": "" }, { "attributeName": "directoryFirstName", "attributeValue": "" }, { "attributeName": "directoryLastName", "attributeValue": "" }, { "attributeName": "directoryBusinessName", "attributeValue": "" } ] ```

data.description_suggestion: Updates telephone number order information including subscriber details, service address, and service attributes. Requires x-customer-number header (Child BusOrg ID or BAN-assigned BusOrg). Supports updating subscriber name, Directory Listing (DL), Customer Service Name (CSN), service address, Caller Name Delivery (CNAM), and E911 options. For Local Inbound (LI) numbers, use orderMappingList to update trunk group and route via customerServiceName attribute; DL and E911 are not supported. For Enhanced Local Service (ELS) numbers, productID, lnpIndicator, and subscriberLineList are required; use orderMappingList for Directory Listing attributes. Returns 202 Accepted indicating the change request has been submitted.
